csv_project_name: DB for MCAS YU2321R & YU2322R Gator Pads Construction
csv_scope_of_work: The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command (NAVFAC) Southwest (SW) Resident Officer in Charge of Construction (ROICC) Yuma has a requirement for two design-build projects. The first project, YU2321R, is to Expand existing Ground/Air Task Oriented Radar AN/TPS-80 (G/ATOR) pad and Support Facility, in support of power (PEG), radar (REG) and communication (CEG) military vehicles at B3266 and B3267. The second project YU2322R, is to demolish the existing pad 3268 and the access road to the pad including the existing turnaround for pad 3268. The project will replace the pad by providing a new pad which meets G/ATOR facility requirements. The pad must include anchor points and ground points per G/ATOR facility requirements and provide a new 120 x 120 turnaround for the G/ATOR pad and provide a new access road. Both projects are located at Marine Corps Air Station (MCAS) Yuma, AZ. The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) is 236220 Commercial and Institutional Building Construction, and the PSC code is Z2PZ Repair Or Alteration Of Other Non-building Facilities. BASE ITEM 000101 Firm fixed price (lump sum) including all bonds, overhead, profit, labor, materials, equipment, transportation, supervision and incidental related work YU2321R Expand existing Ground/Air Task Oriented Radar (G/ATOR) AN/TPS-80 (G/ATOR) pad and Support Facility at Marine Corps Air Station, Yuma, Arizona in accordance with the RFP. BASE ITEM 00102 Firm fixed price (lump sum) including all bonds, overhead, profit, labor, materials, equipment, transportation, supervision and incidental related work YU2322R demolish the existing pad B3268 and the access road to the pad and replace the pad by providing a new pad which meets G/ATOR facility requirements at Marine Corps Air Station, Yuma, Arizona in accordance with the RFP.
